name: Whisper Subtitles
description: Automatically generate AI-powered subtitles for your media library using OpenAI Whisper. Supports translation, multiple models (tiny to large + turbo), word-level timestamps, and intelligent subtitle detection.
overview: Generate accurate subtitles using OpenAI's Whisper AI model with GPU acceleration support

versions.changelog:
Initial release
- Core subtitle generation with Whisper.NET
- Support for all Whisper models (tiny, base, small, medium, large, turbo)
- Translation to English from any language
- Word-level timestamps
- AI identifier in filenames
- Scheduled task for manual generation
- Auto-generation after library scans
- Skip existing subtitles
- Regenerate AI subtitles option
- Multi-platform support (Windows, Linux, macOS)
